restartFinding.cause: The global startup batch waits 14 seconds. Entering focus earlier allowed automatic room association to save the default config before saved pomodoro state was loaded.
restartFinding.fixScope: Hydrate the current storage generation on demand before enabling focus/rest controls or automatic room association; preserve the global startup delay, current running/paused state and account generation guards.

evidencePolicy: Transport failures, ambiguous native control targeting and uncertain input delivery are retained as blocked or invalid diagnostics; they are not counted as product passes. Raw screenshots and operational logs remain in session scratch.
